summary_en: ERI Holdings issued an update to its capital-cost and share-price conscious management framework. Original framework disclosed 2025/07/08; board reviewed current analysis and performance metrics on 2026/07/14.
title_en: Updates to Response Measures for Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Costs and Stock Price
translation_en_brief: On 2026-07-14, ERI Holdings' board of directors reviewed and updated its framework for management conscious of capital costs and stock price, originally announced on 2025-07-08. The disclosure states that the company conducted current analysis and evaluation of the framework and is providing an update. Specific metrics, targets, or revised KPIs are not detailed in this cover notice; full details are contained in an attached supplementary document titled "Updates to Response Measures for Realization of Management Conscious of Capital Costs and Stock Price."
